heroTitle:

Ukucaca kukho konke ukuhweba.
heroLead: Guqula uhambo lwakho lokuhweba ngokuzijwayeza ukubhala izindaba.
accessHint: Chofoza okuthi Zama ukuvula ijenali yakho.
accessReady: Ijenali yakho isilungile. Khetha ithebhu ukuze uqalise.
exampleHint: Isifanekiso senothi, hhayi idatha ye-akhawunti yakho.
foundationMarketText: Ukuhweba kusho ukuthenga nokudayisa amathuluzi emakethe. Ukunikezwa, isidingo, imali, kanye nezindaba kuthonya izintengo. Qopha umongo ngemuva kwesinqumo ngasinye.
foundationRiskText: Zonke izikhundla zingalahlekelwa yimali. Usayizi wendawo, ibanga lokuma, ukusabalala, kanye nezindleko zokwenziwayo kunquma umthelela wako ku-akhawunti yakho.
foundationPlanText: Isizathu sokungenela, ileveli yokungavumelekile yokusetha, kanye nethagethi kuhlelo lwakho. Amanothi akho asiza ukuqhathanisa uhlelo nokwenza kwangempela.
foundationProbabilityText: Ukuhweba okukodwa akusunguli ikhwalithi yesu. Buyekeza uchungechunge lwezikhundla, usayizi wezinzuzo nokulahlekelwa, nokuthi uyilandele ngokungaguquki kanjani inqubo yakho.
purposeTitle: Ijenali iguqula okwenziwayo kube into ongayibuyekeza.
purposeBefore: Ngaphambi kohwebo: bhala isizathu, ingqikithi yemakethe, kanye nomkhawulo wengozi.

purposeDetail: Ijenali isiza ukukhomba imikhuba ukuze ithuthuke. Hlola inqubekelaphambili ngenqubo yakho kanye neqoqo lohwebo, ngaphandle kwezithembiso zembuyiselo yokuhweba.
